selection_rule: Must support both Turkish and English out of the box, or be a documented Turkish-matched Whisper fine-tune used only on the TR subset. English-only 2026 leaderboard models are recorded as rejected, not evaluated as multilingual systems.

asr_selected.notes: Original paper baseline. Lowest WER in the pilot.
Pruned Large-v3 decoder (32->4 layers). Same language set, much faster. Primary 2026 Whisper refresh.
Transformers-native Qwen3-ASR. Turkish is an official support language. Prefer this ID over Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-1.7B.
Same language set as 1.7B, smaller/faster sibling.
Common Voice 17 Turkish fine-tune of Whisper Turbo. Run only on TR-1..TR-3. Addresses limitation (a).

asr_pilot.notes: Same checkpoint as asr_selected. Listed here so --all-pilot reproduces the original four-system set.
Hub ID cited in the paper. This is a pretrained encoder; if the pipeline has no CTC head the run will fail and the exact fine-tune used in the pilot must be recorded here.

The paper said 'SpeechBrain with default greedy/beam settings' but did not pin a Hub ID. This is a documented English LibriSpeech default. Confirm or replace before treating SpeechBrain rows as a reproduction of the pilot.

llm_selected.notes: Public, ungated. Open-weight counterpart to GPT-4.1.
Public, ungated. Open-weight counterpart to GPT-4o-mini.

rejected.reason: 25 European languages only. Turkish is not in the official list (bg,hr,cs,da,nl,en,et,fi,fr,de,el,hu,it,lv,lt,mt,pl,pt,ro,sk,sl,es,sv,ru,uk).
Same 25-language European set as Parakeet v3. No Turkish.
English only. Would repeat the unfair Wav2Vec2/SpeechBrain comparison.
Has Turkish, but CC-BY-NC-4.0 and a 2024 speech-translation stack, not a 2026 ASR specialist.
Has Turkish, but gated (gated=auto) and CC-BY-NC-4.0. Optional later if a HF token is available.
Kept only as the original English-oriented pilot checkpoint, not as a 2026 refresh candidate.
